title: Tantalus
summary: Raleigh names Tantalus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Tantalus, King of Lydia in Ehuds time, sonne of Iupiter by the Nymph Pleta. He is not Tantalus sonne of Hymenaeus brother of Ascalus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. II, sig. 263a
